interfaces.name: Progress
interfaces.input: Task text and observed prefix; only current and preceding frames visible
interfaces.reference: Time-based; VOC is correlation ×100, not stage accuracy

interfaces.name: Independent ranking
interfaces.input: Task text and eight frames from one trajectory
interfaces.reference: Success > suboptimal > failure; Kendall tau-a penalizes predicted ties

interfaces.name: Direct preference
interfaces.reference: Different-quality preference; official sampling, up to 500 pairs per source; source-equal accuracy

interfaces.name: Subtask diagnosis
interfaces.support: 57 questions; 15 trajectory groups; 23 successful, 34 failed subtasks
interfaces.input: Original keyframe montage and subtask question
interfaces.reference: Binary Success label accuracy; composite ROUGE-L

scope.icl: Progress: one same-/similar-task training trajectory with six stage scores. Ranking: three random high/middle/low training trajectories, not requiring task match. RoboFail: five fixed external image-question-answer demos, reported disjoint by test trajectory.

table2_rbm.caveat: Ranking and different-quality preference reuse official Robometer sampling and metric rules. Study seed 44 versus current official default 42; historical paper manifests unavailable. Prompted model outputs and learned heads differ. Robometer v1 tau-a 0.655 is the cited result; v2 is approximately 0.643.

table3_study_ranks.scope: Point-estimate ranks among the three study zero-shot models only; no equal-compute or significance claim

table4_bottle_counterexample.selection: post hoc illustration, not frequency estimate
table4_bottle_counterexample.takeaway: Higher time correlation can coexist with worse terminal completion estimate; MSE about 3.22x larger; public label retained, no independent visual adjudication.

ranking_decomposition.caveat: Weighted outcomes consistent with score, not unweighted counts of independent pairs

table5_robofail_aha.caveat: Exact question identity/count alignment unverified. Requested Astra config does not confirm returned backend equivalence. Published zeros preserved, not interpreted as intrinsic inability.

table6_other_adaptations.caveat: No Astra result on either adaptation; never place our 57-question Astra result in their rankings.

table7_robofail_errors.definition: Failure is positive class; false alarm = actual success predicted failure; miss = actual failure predicted success. Offline question classification, not timestamped alarms.

rouge_decomposition.formula: R = (sum correct-success indicator + sum correct-failure indicator * stemmed ROUGE-L F1 of explanation) / 57
rouge_decomposition.caveat: Not semantic explanation accuracy or causal attribution; lexical overlap and detected-failure subset both matter.

knob_case.reference: Failure because gripper did not close
knob_case.zero_shot: Correct failure label but explanation points to incorrect grasp location
knob_case.five_example: Predicts success on same failed subtask
knob_case.caveat: Post-hoc selected; neither model rationale validated as physical cause

asset_note: PDF figures are vector content; no embedded raster images, robot frames, or videos. Rebuild interactive charts from table data, or crop/render figures. Add source-linked experimental videos separately, with replay/input distinction.

limitations.text: Offline exploratory study; no training, control, policy learning or RL success measured.
RoboFail backend snapshot consistency unconﬁrmed; ICL difference is observational not causal.
Literature protocols and samples differ; no matched leaderboard, SOTA, equal-compute or significance claim.
Time-correlation VOC is not semantic completion accuracy; temporal MSE reference is not independent completion labels.
No demonstrated online localization/recovery/contact-state reasoning/causal diagnosis.
57 questions cluster in 15 sequences; ranking pairs also dependent; no repeat-call variance or uncertainty estimates.
External demos only establish reported trajectory disjointness, not environment/embodiment/pretraining independence.

Release should bind sources, manifests, split composition, frame identities/resolution, prompts/examples, requested and returned models/dates, output budgets, parsing/retry/missing-output rules and scorers.
